gaps.sentence: She often dreams ___ running her own café.
gaps.explanation: dream OF/ABOUT something you would love to happen.

gaps.sentence: She soon got tired ___ answering the same questions.
gaps.explanation: tired OF something = bored/annoyed by it; tired FROM = physically exhausted.
shout AT somebody = be aggressive; shout TO = call so they hear.

gaps.sentence: Fast charging is a big advantage ___ this model.
Everyone laughed ___ his impression of the headmaster.
We're hoping ___ the best results this season.
gaps.explanation: hope FOR something = want and expect it.

gaps.sentence: Is there any excuse ___ being so rude?
